assertions.name: covariance_epic_phase1_two_routes_eliminated
assertions.source: Route 1 (holonomic recurrence) ruled out: no P-recursion order≤4/deg≤5, k=3..28. Route 2 (β-monotonicity) ruled out: E_β[C₂] non-monotone (4→5 increases) while the kernel E_2≥E_3 holds. Focuses the epic on Śniady genus expansion. No fit; no c_k.

description: Phase 1 of the covariance-kernel proof epic (qou-x631): rule out two proof routes for the Δ_λ kernel cov(k)=Σ(f^λ)³(Σc²−C(k,2))≤0. ROUTE 1 (holonomic recurrence ⇒ inductive proof): RULED OUT — cov(k) satisfies no linear recurrence with polynomial coefficients up to order 4/degree 5 (exact, k=3..28; consistent with Σ(f^λ)³ non-holonomic). ROUTE 2 (β-monotonicity of E_β[C₂]=Σf^β C₂/Σf^β): RULED OUT — E_β[C₂] is NOT monotone in β (decreases 2→3→4 but INCREASES 4→5, e.g. k=4: 5.733→5.785), so the kernel is a special β=2→3 fact, not a monotone family; E_2=C(k,2)≥E_3 (the kernel) holds all k≤18. NET: the kernel is non-P-recursive and non-monotone-family — a special analytic statement; the remaining route is Śniady's genus expansion (obstruction: f^λ is the exponential DIMENSION, not a bounded character ratio, so Kerov-CLT is not directly applicable). scope-(a) route-elimination; no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.
